description: Which archived upstream scenarios become bitwire/1 evidence, and with which scope. Applied by scripts/protocol-scenarios.mjs; the derivatives under scenarios/ record the result.

excluded.reason: Exercises the identity.check exchange, which bitwire/1's scope excludes (Bitlink).
Exercises a test-only frame recorder, one runtime's instrumentation.

defective.reason: Its regular expression assumes the members id, traceparent and tracestate arrive in that order, on one line, with no whitespace after the colons; the envelope orders no members.
It expects Nightseam Go's exact refusal message; the tunnel requires only that the message name the family.

Its raw frames name the plain method echo, and it expects the request to be served. Serving a plain name needs a plain-name handler, which revision 1 does not require: a name nothing handles is answered method_not_found (SCOPE.md, Paths).
